_comment: Streams that resolve successfully but do not play the advertised content.
These cannot be detected by HTTP status: the server returns 200 and a valid
HLS manifest, so only a rule like this can exclude them.
Users can add their own rules in blocklist.json inside the Winnotix data
directory (%APPDATA%\Winnotix). User rules are merged with these; a user
rule with the same id replaces the built-in one, and setting 'enabled' to
false there switches a built-in rule off.
Each rule needs an id and a reason, plus host_suffix and/or url_regex.

rules.reason: Pluto TV serves a ~25s takedown notice instead of the stream
rules.notes: Every sampled entry across all groups returned an HLS manifest whose segments are named 'ptv_takedownslates'. Affects live channels as well as VOD. Remove this rule if Pluto restores third-party stitcher access.
